quality_gate.failure_sample: Six agentskills specification forks, four html-ppt-skill forks and three cybersecurity-skill forks repeated identical default-branch HEAD fingerprints; all topic-relevant hits remained below the 1000-star eligibility gate.

previous_retrospective.note: This is the first Skills index retrospective under repository-research-v1.0; the preceding May 2 run predates the retrospective contract.

next_action.hypothesis: Grouping same-parent repositories with an identical default-branch HEAD before provisional classification will reduce repeated classification work while preserving every repository identity.
next_action.metric: In the next shard, report repository identities, fingerprint clusters, identities classified through a cluster, and manual spot-check disagreements.
next_action.rollback_condition: Rollback cluster-assisted classification if any grouped repository has a different parent, different HEAD, or requires a different provisional classification after metadata verification.
